propositions: Environment variable REBAR_DETECTED_BY is read at ticket creation (composer.create_core) and stamped into the detected_by event field; CLI, library, and MCP filers all receive the stamp via a unified seam.
Optional --detected-by flag overrides the environment variable; explicit param takes precedence over env var; absence of both leaves the field unset.
Normalization applies strip() + lowercase; empty or whitespace-only values are treated as unset (field absent); unknown tokens are stamped verbatim without enum enforcement or creation failure.

process_create projects detected_by present-only into compiled state mirroring source_* blocks; events without the field reduce byte-identically to the pre-change baseline, ensuring backward compatibility.

Jira inbound CREATE events (apply_inbound_records.py) bypass composer.create_core and intentionally do not receive detected_by stamping to avoid mis-attributing human-authored tickets to the reconciler daemon.
